The vision tower, the linear-attention projections and the multi-token-prediction head stay bf16 — the same configuration as the FP8-dynamic base this project serves in production, so numerics match what the hosted API runs.

sources.title: CaptchaKraken/js/README.md at main · JWriter20/CaptchaKraken
sources.snippet: captchakraken The TypeScript browser driver for CaptchaKraken. Hand it a Playwright/Puppeteer Page; it finds the captcha, reads the grid with a fine-tuned Qwen3.5-9B vision model on vLLM, clicks human-like, and verifies through to a token. Full docs — demo videos, accuracy, self-hosting — live in the main repo CaptchaKraken.
